iran_nuclear.name: IRAN NUCLEAR
iran_nuclear.notes: IAEA access/continuity gaps and reported near-bomb-grade stockpile uncertainty at Isfahan keep the nuclear track rising; diplomatic talks remain active and cap the immediate device-risk track.

iran_conventional.name: IRAN WAR
iran_conventional.notes: Hormuz controlled/restricted-navigation friction persists after AP reported U.S. interception of Iranian attacks on Navy ships; negotiations remain active, preventing an imminent full regional-war break.

israel_lebanon.name: ISRAEL-LEBANON
israel_lebanon.notes: Reuters reporting shows Israel-Hezbollah fighting persisted despite the truce extension, with Israeli strikes in southern Lebanon and Hezbollah calling the arrangement meaningless; diplomacy remains active but obstructed.

turkey.name: TURKEY
turkey.notes: Turkey-Israel/Syria rivalry remains elevated after fresh reporting on Ankara bracing for regional competition, but the scan found no new Turkey-centered weapons-test or direct military-contact trigger.

india.name: INDIA-PAKISTAN
india.notes: India-Pakistan results were mostly stale 2025 conflict background and border-damage follow-up; current scan found no fresh force-deployment or official atomic-warning trigger.

russia.name: RUSSIA-NATO
russia.notes: Russia-NATO risk rises above the imminent threshold as Belarus held drills involving Russian nuclear weapons and Lukashenko appeared in exercise coverage; direct NATO kinetic contact remains absent.

china.name: CHINA-TAIWAN
china.notes: Reuters May 19 reporting has Taiwan calling China military actions the greatest source of regional tension; persistent PLA pressure keeps the tracker critical without a confirmed new blockade phase.

north_korea.name: NORTH KOREA
north_korea.notes: DPRK risk edges up on AP/PBS reporting of short-range ballistic missile activity and April Reuters launch context; no device-event confirmation appeared in the fresh scan.

russia_ukraine.name: RUSSIA-UKRAINE
russia_ukraine.notes: Russia-Ukraine stays critical after Reuters reported Russia pounding Kyiv in the heaviest wartime drone attack over two nights, with broader drone/missile tempo still high.

pakistan_afghanistan.name: PAKISTAN-AFGHANISTAN
pakistan_afghanistan.notes: Pakistan-Afghanistan scan again centered on February border-war material and older Reuters/Al Jazeera clashes; fresh May escalation indicators were weak.

sudan.name: SUDAN
sudan.notes: Sudan remains critical as RSF/SAF conflict pressure, drone warfare, and infrastructure/supply-route strikes continue to drive regional spillover risk.

israel_palestine.name: ISRAEL-PALESTINE
israel_palestine.notes: Gaza remains imminent: AP/UN reporting shows the ceasefire fraying, humanitarian conditions worsening, and the Board of Peace moving to the UNSC to press Hamas disarmament.

south_sudan_abyei.name: SOUTH SUDAN / ABYEI
south_sudan_abyei.notes: South Sudan/Abyei remains elevated: UNISFA/Security Council reporting shows higher incident/fatality counts, unauthorized armed presence, and stalled political mechanisms.
